question: Why does Tesla's revenue history in this data start in fiscal year 2011?
summary: No answer within the step/time budget.

H-749b8b.text: Tesla did not submit XBRL‑tagged revenue facts in SEC filings before FY2011, so no rows exist for those years.

H-099e37.text: Early Tesla revenue facts exist but were flagged as invalid by the Zetaris data‑quality rule (e.g., duplicate period_frame null) and removed from the usable view.

H-3bf73d.text: Tesla was a private company until its IPO in June 2010; therefore it was not required to file periodic SEC reports (10‑K/10‑Q) before FY2011, resulting in no revenue data.

H-bf3981.text: The query only examines the 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' concept, which was not used in Tesla’s XBRL tagging before FY2011; the older 'Revenues' concept would show earlier data.

H-9dba6f.text: Tesla’s SIC code is missing or mismatched in the reference sic_codes_table, causing an inner join that drops its revenue facts when the unified semantic layer enforces the FK constraint.
